# Remove liked songs from queue, from highest position to lowest to avoid index shifting
liked_song_ids = {19, 103, 109, 133, 135}
# Get current queue positions for these songs
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
positions_to_remove = [song["position"] for song in queue if song["song_id"] in liked_song_ids]
# Sort descending
positions_to_remove.sort(reverse=True)
for pos in positions_to_remove:
    apis.spotify.remove_song_from_queue(position=pos, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Removed position {pos}")
